results.title: Iron Maiden Drummer Nicko McBrain Declares Trump Should Be Imprisoned, Amid 50th‑Year Tour
results.description: Nicko McBrain, famed drummer of heavy‑metal icon Iron Maiden, publicly denounced former President Donald Trump, refusing to play golf with him and urging legal action. The 74‑year‑old drummer shared his political grievances while the band celebrates its 50th anniversary tour and Hall of Fame induction, highlighting the evolving role of musicians in political discourse.
